assertions.name: dimension_analysis_present
assertions.description: Review includes systematic analysis of 8 dimensions (Background, Problem, Solution, Boundaries, Integration, Outcome, Validation Scope, Acceptance Criteria)
assertions.check: Output contains table or structured list covering all 8 dimensions with status indicators (✅/⚠️/❌/❓)

assertions.name: issues_identified
assertions.description: Review identifies specific issues: omissions, ambiguities, contradictions, or clarification points
assertions.check: Output contains at least one concrete issue with location, risk explanation, and recommendation

assertions.name: actionable_recommendations
assertions.description: Recommendations are specific and actionable (not generic like 'add more details')
assertions.check: Each recommendation specifies what to add/change, where in the document, and provides concrete example or guidance

assertions.name: clear_verdict
assertions.description: Review provides final verdict: Approved, Needs Revision, or Blocked
assertions.check: Output ends with explicit verdict statement with reasoning

assertions.name: project_context_checks
assertions.description: Review considers project-specific context (Phaser 3, TypeScript, Hermes-Agent, existing architecture)
assertions.check: Output references project architecture, directory structure, naming conventions, or existing systems
